run_experiment: run a BenchMark-RL experiment with MAPPO algorithm on the VMAS balance task
load_experiment_config: load an ExperimentConfig from the base_experiment YAML configuration file
load_vmas_task: load a VMAS task configuration from its YAML file such as balance
load_mappo_config: load a MappoConfig algorithm configuration from the mappo YAML file
create_experiment: create an Experiment instance with task, algorithm, and MLP model configs then run it
